note: Each row: settings in force, a CONCERT input frequency (inputHz), and what the engine must report. expect.midi is the nearest TEMPERED note (not the nearest equal-tempered one), in WRITTEN pitch: concert midi minus transposition. expect.cents is relative to that note's combined target (temperament + stretch + A4 calibration). expect.targetHz is in the written domain too: the concert target times 2^(-transposition/12). With transposition 0 it is simply the target. The engine measures every offset from a fixed 440 Hz anchor: targetOffsetCents = temperament + stretch(sounding midi) + 1200*log2(a4/440). expect.span = [halfBelow, halfAbove]: cents from the target to each cell edge, halfway to the neighbouring tempered targets (getCellCentSpan). expect.needleEven / needleCentered = [pct, targetPct] from getNeedleCellPosition: needle and target line, 0 = flat edge of the cell, 1 = sharp edge. custom rows carry the RAW table; normalize it first (see customNormalization). anchor is temperamentAnchor ("center" | "a4").
